name: eó fis

attributes.attribute: the bubbles of wisdom in the well

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Eó fis is the fish of knowledge in Irish lore. Bubbles named eó fis rise in a sacred well. Hazel nuts fall into the water and give the fish wisdom. Eating the fish passes wisdom to a person. This salmon of wisdom is sometimes called Fintan. See also SALMON.

okr.objective: Rewrite the eó fis cross-reference with the fish of knowledge claims.
key_results: Define eó fis as bubbles of knowledge
Record the hazel nuts that grant wisdom
Name Fintan as one of the fish identities
okr.evidence: Monaghan, The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore, 2008, s.v. eó fis.
